Container.Name: FrigateIdentityService
Container.Overview:
Person re-identification service for Frigate NVR. Maintains identity continuity for detected persons using facial recognition (primary) and ReID embeddings (fallback). Publishes identity events and per-person snapshots over MQTT for Home Assistant dashboards and automations.
Requires an existing MQTT broker and Frigate NVR instance on your local network. No GPU required — runs on CPU.
Container.Description:
Frigate Identity Service connects to your Frigate NVR and MQTT broker to provide persistent person identity across camera views. When Frigate recognises a face it uses that label; otherwise it extracts a re-identification (ReID) embedding and matches it against stored embeddings to maintain continuity.
**What it publishes over MQTT:** - `identity/person/{person_id}` — identity events with source and confidence - `identity/snapshots/{person_id}` — latest snapshot per known person (retained) - `identity/vehicle/detected` — vehicle detection events
**Requirements:** - Frigate NVR reachable over HTTP - MQTT broker (e.g. Mosquitto) reachable from the container - `/data` volume mounted for embedding persistence across restarts
**Home Assistant companion integration:** https://github.com/awayman/frigate-identity-ha

Config.Name: Data Path
Config.Description: Persistent storage for embeddings and debug logs. Mount a host path so learned identities survive container restarts.

Config.Name: MQTT Broker
Config.Description: Hostname or IP address of your MQTT broker.

Config.Name: MQTT Port
Config.Description: MQTT broker port.

Config.Name: MQTT Username
Config.Description: MQTT authentication username. Leave blank if your broker does not require authentication.

Config.Name: MQTT Password
Config.Description: MQTT authentication password. Leave blank if your broker does not require authentication.

Config.Name: Frigate Host
Config.Description: Full URL (with port) of your Frigate NVR HTTP API. Example: http://192.168.1.50:5000

Config.Name: ReID Model
Config.Description: Re-identification model variant. Options: osnet_x1_0 (recommended), osnet_x0_75, osnet_x0_5, osnet_x0_25, osnet_ibn_x1_0, osnet_ain_x1_0, resnet50.

Config.Name: ReID Device
Config.Description: Device for ReID inference. Options: auto, cpu, cuda. Use cpu unless you have configured GPU passthrough.

Config.Name: ReID Similarity Threshold
Config.Description: Minimum cosine similarity score (0.0–1.0) required to match a detected person to a stored embedding. Lower values match more loosely; higher values are stricter.

Config.Name: Embeddings DB Path
Config.Description: Path inside the container where person embeddings are stored. Should be inside the mounted /data volume.

Config.Name: Embedding Retention Mode
Config.Description: Embedding retention policy. Options: age_prune (prune embeddings older than EMBEDDING_MAX_AGE_HOURS), full_clear_daily (wipe all embeddings daily at EMBEDDING_FULL_CLEAR_TIME), manual (never auto-clear).

Config.Name: Embedding Max Age (hours)
Config.Description: Maximum age in hours before an embedding is pruned. Only used when EMBEDDING_RETENTION_MODE=age_prune.

Config.Name: Embedding Prune Interval (minutes)
Config.Description: How often (in minutes) the service checks for and removes expired embeddings. Only used when EMBEDDING_RETENTION_MODE=age_prune.

Config.Name: Embedding Full Clear Time
Config.Description: Time of day (HH:MM, 24-hour) to wipe all embeddings. Only used when EMBEDDING_RETENTION_MODE=full_clear_daily.

Config.Name: Snapshot Fetch Mode
Config.Description: How to obtain snapshots for ReID input. Options: clean_if_available (prefer Frigate clean snapshots), snapshot (always use event snapshot), thumbnail (use thumbnail only).

Config.Name: Snapshot Local Crop
Config.Description: When using clean snapshots, crop locally from Frigate event box metadata for a tighter person crop before ReID.

Config.Name: Publish Identity Event Snapshot
Config.Description: Publish API-fetched per-event snapshots to identity/snapshots/{person_id}. Set to false to use only the MQTT snapshot stream (legacy mode).

Config.Name: Snapshot ReID JPEG Quality
Config.Description: JPEG quality (1–95) used when encoding snapshots for ReID input.

Config.Name: Snapshot Display JPEG Quality
Config.Description: JPEG quality (1–95) used when publishing snapshots to MQTT display topics.

Config.Name: Snapshot Crop Padding X
Config.Description: Horizontal padding added around the detected person bounding box (fraction of box width) when cropping snapshots.

Config.Name: Snapshot Crop Padding Y
Config.Description: Vertical padding added around the detected person bounding box (fraction of box height) when cropping snapshots.

Config.Name: Snapshot Correlation Window (seconds)
Config.Description: Seconds within which an MQTT snapshot is correlated to a detected person. Only relevant when PUBLISH_IDENTITY_EVENT_SNAPSHOT=false.

Config.Name: Max Tracked Persons per Camera
Config.Description: Maximum number of persons tracked simultaneously per camera for MQTT snapshot correlation.

Config.Name: Debug Logging Enabled
Config.Description: Enable debug logging for misidentification analysis. Saves per-event snapshots and JSONL logs to DEBUG_LOG_PATH.

Config.Name: Debug Log Path
Config.Description: Path inside the container to store debug logs and snapshots. Should be inside the mounted /data volume.

Config.Name: Debug Save Embeddings
Config.Description: Include full embedding vectors in debug JSON output. Significantly increases debug log size; only enable when investigating embedding quality.

Config.Name: Debug Retention Days
Config.Description: Number of days to retain debug logs before automatic deletion.
